description: This file is a PHP script responsible for managing the repair and normalization of UTF encoding within the SuiteCRM administrative module. It handles user permissions, displays status templates, initiates repair processes, and schedules background jobs for UTF encoding correction.

classes.name: NormalizeRecords
classes.description: A class providing static methods for managing UTF normalization and repair status.

classes.name: NormalizeRecordsSchedulerJob
classes.description: A class responsible for scheduling background jobs related to normalization tasks.

methods.name: runAll
methods.description: Executes the normalization process on the dataset, optionally synchronously, returning a result with success status and messages.
